summary: Small and clean is the story early week — prime ESE angles at knee-to-waist size mean glassy dawn log sessions but nothing to rearrange your life over. Rockaway's fine for the home-break longboard fix, but the only drives worth considering are Manasquan Monday for a clean near-2ft prime day and Ditch Friday for offshore 2-3ft. Midweek blows out hard Wednesday, Thursday brings size but wind and bad angles, and the weekend outlook stays small — get your clean waves in the mornings.
